Phainon hadn’t been that old- twelve, maybe- when his parents decided to take him out to a distant farm in Castrum Kremnos. Their own farm in Aedes Elysiae was all he had ever known, and he hadn’t been prepared for all the new sights he came across during the trip. Castrum Kremnos was wildly different from the village Phainon lived in; its buildings proudly bore colors of blue, gold, and white, regardless of what their purpose was. It was also far hotter and more humid than Aedes Elysiae, with a rocky terrain making up the majority of its environment. Phainon had been most excited, however, for the farm that made their final destination. When they finally arrived, it only took a single look at his pleading face for his parents to smile and send him off, allowing him to wander while they spoke with the farm’s owner. Phainon ran off without hesitation, finding the nearest barn and eagerly trying to find a way inside.

As a village boy, Phainon didn’t know much about his neighboring city-states, but he did know how coveted Kremnoan animals were; from military to farm, Castrum Kremnos seemed to dominate the market. He and Cyrene’s parents always had something good to say about them. Kremnoan animal products were supposedly the best in Amphoreus, and Cyrene’s parents had talked them up so much that his mom and dad were convinced to invest in it. Phainon desperately wanted to see how special they were with his own eyes, and now that he had been granted the opportunity, he tugged open the barn door, wiggled inside, and suddenly-

“It is one,” the other boy (?) confirmed, his tail (his tail!!!) swaying behind him. “Have you never been to a farm before?”
